description: Hardware acceleration for 8/16/32/64-bit CRC variants processing 4 bytes per invocation.

instructions.name: crc64_ecma_step32b
instructions.pseudocode: uint64_t crc = ((uint64_t)in[1] << 32) | in[0]; uint32_t data = in[2]; for(int i=0; i<4; i++) { uint8_t val = (data >> (i*8)) & 0xFF; uint64_t c = crc ^ ((uint64_t)val << 56); for(int j=0; j<8; j++) { uint64_t mask = (uint64_t)0 - (c >> 63); c = ((c << 1) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFull) ^ (0x42F0E1EBA9EA3693ull & mask); } crc = c; } out[0] = (uint32_t)crc; out[1] = (uint32_t)(crc >> 32); out[2] = 0;
instructions.semantics: Reads a 64-bit CRC state from in[0..1] and 4 bytes of data from in[2]. Performs 4 bytes of CRC64-ECMA (poly 0x42F0E1EBA9EA3693) computation, writing the new 64-bit state to out[0..1] and padding out[2] with 0.

instructions.name: crcccitt_step32b
instructions.pseudocode: uint16_t crc = (uint16_t)in[0]; uint32_t data = in[1]; for(int i=0; i<4; i++) { uint8_t val = (data >> (i*8)) & 0xFF; uint16_t c = crc ^ ((uint16_t)val << 8); for(int j=0; j<8; j++) { uint16_t mask = (uint16_t)0 - (c >> 15); c = ((c << 1) & 0xFFFF) ^ (0x1021 & mask); } crc = c; } out[0] = crc; out[1] = 0;
instructions.semantics: Reads a 16-bit CRC state from in[0] and 4 bytes of data from in[1]. Performs 4 bytes of CRC-CCITT (poly 0x1021) computation, writing the new 16-bit state to out[0] and padding out[1] with 0.

instructions.name: crc32_step32b
instructions.pseudocode: uint32_t crc = in[0]; uint32_t data = in[1]; for(int i=0; i<4; i++) { uint8_t val = (data >> (i*8)) & 0xFF; uint32_t c = crc ^ val; for(int j=0; j<8; j++) { uint32_t mask = (uint32_t)0 - (c & 1); c = (c >> 1) ^ (0xEDB88320ul & mask); } crc = c; } out[0] = crc; out[1] = 0;
instructions.semantics: Reads a 32-bit CRC state from in[0] and 4 bytes of data from in[1]. Performs 4 bytes of CRC32 (poly 0xEDB88320) right-shifting computation, writing the new 32-bit state to out[0] and padding out[1] with 0.

instructions.name: crc16_step32b
instructions.pseudocode: uint16_t crc = (uint16_t)in[0]; uint32_t data = in[1]; for(int i=0; i<4; i++) { uint8_t val = (data >> (i*8)) & 0xFF; uint16_t c = crc ^ val; for(int j=0; j<8; j++) { uint16_t mask = (uint16_t)0 - (c & 1); c = (c >> 1) ^ (0xA001 & mask); } crc = c; } out[0] = crc; out[1] = 0;
instructions.semantics: Reads a 16-bit CRC state from in[0] and 4 bytes of data from in[1]. Performs 4 bytes of CRC-16 (poly 0xA001) right-shifting computation, writing the new 16-bit state to out[0] and padding out[1] with 0.

instructions.name: crcdnp_step32b
instructions.pseudocode: uint16_t crc = (uint16_t)in[0]; uint32_t data = in[1]; for(int i=0; i<4; i++) { uint8_t val = (data >> (i*8)) & 0xFF; uint16_t c = crc ^ val; for(int j=0; j<8; j++) { uint16_t mask = (uint16_t)0 - (c & 1); c = (c >> 1) ^ (0xA6BC & mask); } crc = c; } out[0] = crc; out[1] = 0;
instructions.semantics: Reads a 16-bit CRC state from in[0] and 4 bytes of data from in[1]. Performs 4 bytes of CRC-DNP (poly 0xA6BC) right-shifting computation, writing the new 16-bit state to out[0] and padding out[1] with 0.

instructions.name: crc8_step32b
instructions.pseudocode: uint8_t crc = (uint8_t)in[0]; uint32_t data = in[1]; for(int i=0; i<4; i++) { uint8_t val = (data >> (i*8)) & 0xFF; uint8_t c = crc ^ val; for(int j=0; j<8; j++) { uint8_t mask = (uint8_t)0 - (c >> 7); c = ((c << 1) & 0xFF) ^ (0x31 & mask); } crc = c; } out[0] = crc; out[1] = 0;
instructions.semantics: Reads an 8-bit CRC state from in[0] and 4 bytes of data from in[1]. Performs 4 bytes of CRC-8 (poly 0x31) left-shifting computation, writing the new 8-bit state to out[0] and padding out[1] with 0.
